result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module's tests pass, but I didn't add a test for the new name or run it against a real analysis root.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, just before `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the same `updateLandscape` method, with the same options. That method now takes the command name and description, so `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed. `updateLandscape -help` prints what it did before.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape` and `updateLandscape`. It says `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.
